source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I had this idea of having an instant quote calculator. This would be to give clients the ability to fill out a form or quiz that gives questions on what services they wish to receive and the form calculates an estimated price in real time. I was looking into it and it seems a bit complicated. would that be something you can do?

value_updates.input_behavior: ask clients which services they wish to receive

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thank you so much for the clarification. In regard to the calculator, we have all of our services itemized. The more services they get, the more we can bundle. So the calculator would have to know when the services they choose qualify for a bundle or not. Otherwise it would be a simple addition for individual services. I imagine it would look like a survey. Potentially as follows:

How many sqft is the property (if under 1000 pricing tier 1, if 1001 - 2000 pricing tier 2, f 2001 - 3000 pricing tier 3, if 2001 - 3000 pricing tier 4, if 3001 + pricing tier 5 (*answers 1253 sqft* gets put into pricing tier 2)
Photos (yes/no) Yes = +200 No = +0 (*answers yes))*
*Videos? (yes/no)* Yes = +200 No = +0 (*answers yes))*
what is the address (calculates distance from home office) (if over 25 miles charge $50 dollar surcharge) (*Answers address and is 28 miles away))) +50*
*(qualifies for basic bundle) -$100*
*(presses submit)*
*Displays total : $350*

value_updates.pricing_logic: apply a qualifying bundle when selected services meet bundle rules; otherwise add individual service prices
